The message to developers is that land, power, and a finished building matter more than a pitch deck. ⁠Anita Verma-Lallian⁠ has been selling exactly that. […]

headline: Amazon and Meta reportedly in talks to lift blockade on AI agent Muse
abstract: Amazon and Meta are discussing a potential deal that would end a two-month-long blockade of Muse.

headline: The questions Jensen Huang and Nvidia will still have to answer about Megaspeed
